title: NPE on GATT
symptom: A NullPointerException occurs in the BluetoothGatt callback when the connection state changes, causing an unhandled exception in the callback. The log shows a disconnect from the GATT server followed by the NPE.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that the BluetoothGatt object is null when the callback is invoked, leading to the NPE.
fix: The issue was addressed by a commit that traps the NPE, and further corrections were made in the September 9th nightly. The issue was marked as resolved.
